name: Morvedra Nou
description: An adults-only rural hotel in the Ciutadella countryside, on the way to the southern coves, with rustic rooms opening onto their own terrace or garden — some with private pools — and traditional Menorcan cooking in its restaurant. Open June to October: a country summer ten minutes from Macarella.

practicalInfo.acceso: Ciutadella countryside, about 7 km from town, towards the southern coves.
practicalInfo.horario: Season June to October; check dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Adults only, outdoor pool, rooms with terrace or garden (some with private pools), Menorcan restaurant.

seo.description: Morvedra Nou, Ciutadella: an adults-only rural hotel on the way to the southern coves, with pool and Menorcan cooking.
